title: Reproducibility Code Package for: Dirty, Shameful, Not My Own? Traumatized Sexuality as a Pathway From Childhood Sexual Abuse to Attitudes Toward Women's Genitals
description: Complete statistical analysis, Full Information Maximum Likelihood (FIML) expectation-maximization path modeling, Little's (1988) MCAR test, Multiple Imputation (MICE), outlier-robust regression, Shapley value dominance analysis, and publication figure generation code for 'Dirty, Shameful, Not My Own? Traumatized Sexuality as a Pathway From Childhood Sexual Abuse to Attitudes Toward Women's Genitals' (Sperber & Gewirtz-Meydan).
